method: Unchanged pipe-delimited header and rows selected from the official ACS 5-year table-based summary file. GEO_ID 0400000US15 is state; 0500000US15xxx is county; 620L900US15xxx is House; 610U900US15xxx is Senate. Read B22003_E006 and B22003_M006 directly; no subtraction, aggregation, interpolation or modeled eligibility. The summary file has no annotation columns. The canonical endpoint identifies the ACS dataset; the method in each fact records the actual bulk download URL.
retrieval_note: Census API observation queries redirected to missing_key.html without a key. Metadata was accessible. Used the official public bulk table instead; no replacement or invented observations.
limitations: ACS national poverty thresholds differ from Hawaiʻi program guidelines: this is a lower-bound outreach indicator, not an eligibility count.
Survey answers undercount benefit receipt; nonreceipt is self-reported and does not establish an unmet entitlement.
DHS determines eligibility after reviewing household circumstances.
independent_reproduction: python -m scripts.independent_snap --fetch prints House 1 from a fresh bulk download without app, ETL or config imports; compare against the committed golden fixture.
